user.title: Virtual EV Charging Station
user.description: Configure the basic parameters and sensors to calculate net kWh and manage smart charging.

data_description.enchufe_switch: The physical smart switch or relay that turns the vehicle charger on or off.
data_description.enchufe_energia: Sensor measuring the total accumulated consumption of the plug in kWh. This is critical for hitting the exact 80% automatic stop.
data_description.enchufe_potencia: Sensor measuring the instantaneous consumption in watts (W) of the charger. Used to detect the power drop when the BMS finishes charging.
data_description.sensor_solar: Sensor (or template sensor) measuring the gross generation in watts (W) from your combined solar inverters.
data_description.capacidad_bateria: The total factory capacity of your vehicle's battery in kWh (e.g., 13.0).
data_description.potencia_carga: The default charging speed of your vehicle in kW (e.g., 1.4). Used to calculate the remaining time countdown.
data_description.umbral_solar: The total photovoltaic generation required in watts (W) for the charger to automatically turn on in solar mode.
data_description.servicio_notificacion: The name of the alert service you use (e.g., notify.telegram_kiko). Leave it completely blank if you prefer the system to run silently.
